name: breakdown
title: Breakdown
description: A whole as its parts along one bar, each as wide as its share.
use: What a total is made of: storage by kind, a bill by service, a budget and what is left of it. The stylesheet draws the bar and its legend from one list, so the list is still the data. Keep it to five parts or so, largest first; the parts need not add up to anything, each takes its share of their sum.

instead.when: The amounts are compared with each other, not with their sum
There is one amount within a range
It is a task that completes

classes.name: breakdown
classes.description: The list: an 8px bar of segments 2px apart, and a legend that wraps under it

classes.name: breakdown-rows
classes.description: The legend as rows on hairlines, one to a part, with each figure at the end

classes.name: breakdown-item
classes.description: One part; set --value in its style. It has no box of its own: its segment joins the bar and its label joins the legend. Segments are steps of one ink, darkest first

classes.name: breakdown-rest
classes.description: The part that is not used, such as free space: a well instead of ink, and a ring instead of a dot in the legend

classes.name: breakdown-label
classes.description: The part's name in the legend, after a dot of its segment's color

classes.name: breakdown-value
classes.description: The part's figure as text, muted, inside breakdown-label

properties.name: --value
properties.description: The part's number; the stylesheet reads 0 when it is not set

properties.name: --breakdown-color
properties.description: The ink the segments are steps of

properties.name: --breakdown-fill
properties.description: One segment's color, and its dot's. By default a step of --breakdown-color by the item's place; set it for a part that carries a status
